run_rule: ONE call per run (DRY, REAL). pm substitutes ONLY the tokens ${START_MS} and ${END_MS} (epoch ms integers, END - START <= 3600000), every occurrence, and sends `body` as written. start/end are JSON NUMBERS (no quotes): this file is a template and is valid JSON only after the fill. An error or a timeout = STOP, no re-run.

spec.name: F
spec.query: WITH (SELECT (groupArrayIf(trace_id, jobs = 1), count(), countIf(jobs = 1), arrayFlatten(groupArrayIf(dl_ids, jobs = 1))) FROM (SELECT trace_id, countIf(name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download') AS dl_n, uniqExactIf(attributes_number['dev_health.job.id'], name = 'dev_health.job.execute') AS jobs, groupArrayIf(span_id, name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download') AS dl_ids FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE ts_bucket_start >= intDiv(toUInt64(${START_MS}), 1000) - 1800 AND ts_bucket_start <= intDiv(toUInt64(${END_MS}), 1000) AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${START_MS})) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${END_MS})) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'dev-health-go-sync-provider' AND name IN ('dev_health.job.execute', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download') GROUP BY trace_id HAVING dl_n > 0)) AS tt SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'traces' AS section, '' AS span_name, 'tests_traces' AS label, toUInt64(tt.2) AS n, toFloat64(0) AS s, toFloat64(0) AS a, toFloat64(0) AS p50, toFloat64(0) AS p95, toFloat64(0) AS mx, toFloat64(0) AS mn UNION ALL SELECT 'traces', '', 'single_unit_tests_traces', toUInt64(tt.3), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0) UNION ALL SELECT r.1, r.2, '', toUInt64(r.3), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0) FROM (SELECT [('control', '', count()), ('presence', 'dev_health.provider.request', countIf(name = 'dev_health.provider.request')), ('presence', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download', countIf(name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download')), ('presence', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse', countIf(name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse')), ('presence', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_prepare', countIf(name = 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_prepare')), ('presence', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_commit', countIf(name = 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_commit'))] AS rows FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE ts_bucket_start >= intDiv(toUInt64(${START_MS}), 1000) - 1800 AND ts_bucket_start <= intDiv(toUInt64(${END_MS}), 1000) AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${START_MS})) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${END_MS})) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'dev-health-go-sync-provider') ARRAY JOIN rows AS r UNION ALL SELECT 'keys', name, multiIf(name = 'dev_health.provider.request' AND has(['provider', 'http.request.method', 'http.route', 'family', 'dev_health.provider.target', 'dev_health.provider.attempts', 'dev_health.provider.gate_wait_ms', 'dev_health.provider.budget_ms', 'dev_health.provider.lease_ms', 'http.response.status_code', 'outcome', 'error.type'], k), k, name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download' AND has(['dev_health.artifact.bytes', 'dev_health.artifact.listed_bytes', 'dev_health.provider.requests', 'outcome'], k), k, name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse' AND has(['dev_health.artifact.bytes', 'dev_health.tests.reports', 'dev_health.tests.suites', 'dev_health.tests.cases', 'outcome'], k), k, name IN ('dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_prepare', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_commit') AND has(['dev_health.chunk.count', 'dev_health.chunk.payload_bytes', 'dev_health.chunk.effects', 'outcome'], k), k, 'OUTSIDE_ALLOW_LIST') AS key_name, count(), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0), toFloat64(0) FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 ARRAY JOIN arrayDistinct(arrayConcat(mapKeys(attributes_string), mapKeys(attributes_number), mapKeys(attributes_bool))) AS k WHERE ts_bucket_start >= intDiv(toUInt64(${START_MS}), 1000) - 1800 AND ts_bucket_start <= intDiv(toUInt64(${END_MS}), 1000) AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${START_MS})) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${END_MS})) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'dev-health-go-sync-provider' AND name IN ('dev_health.provider.request', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_prepare', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_commit') GROUP BY name, key_name UNION ALL SELECT 'agg', name, m.1 AS metric, count(), sum(m.2), avg(m.2), quantile(0.5)(m.2), quantile(0.95)(m.2), max(m.2), min(m.2) FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 ARRAY JOIN multiIf(name = 'dev_health.job.execute', [('dur_ms', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6))], name = 'dev_health.provider.request', arrayConcat([('dur_ms', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6)), ('gate_wait_ms', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.provider.gate_wait_ms'])), ('lease_ms', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.provider.lease_ms'])), ('budget_ms', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.provider.budget_ms'])), ('attempts', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.provider.attempts']))], if(has(tt.4, parent_span_id), [('dur_ms_in_download', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6))], [('dur_ms_outside_download', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6))]), if(attributes_string['dev_health.provider.target'] = 'redirect', [('dur_ms_redirect', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6))], CAST([], 'Array(Tuple(String, Float64))'))), name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download', [('dur_ms', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6)), ('artifact_bytes', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.artifact.bytes'])), ('listed_bytes', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.artifact.listed_bytes'])), ('requests', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.provider.requests']))], name = 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse', [('dur_ms', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6)), ('artifact_bytes', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.artifact.bytes'])), ('reports', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.tests.reports'])), ('suites', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.tests.suites'])), ('cases', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.tests.cases']))], [('dur_ms', toFloat64(toFloat64(duration_nano) / 1e6)), ('chunks', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.chunk.count'])), ('payload_bytes', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.chunk.payload_bytes'])), ('effects', toFloat64(attributes_number['dev_health.chunk.effects']))]) AS m WHERE ts_bucket_start >= intDiv(toUInt64(${START_MS}), 1000) - 1800 AND ts_bucket_start <= intDiv(toUInt64(${END_MS}), 1000) AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${START_MS})) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(${END_MS})) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'dev-health-go-sync-provider' AND name IN ('dev_health.job.execute', 'dev_health.provider.request', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_download', 'dev_health.github_tests.artifact_parse', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_prepare', 'dev_health.provider_unit.chunk_commit') AND has(tt.1, trace_id) GROUP BY name, metric) ORDER BY section, span_name, label LIMIT 300
